description:
Create a monitor

Creates a monitor for one endpoint with one or more resources (the params of each request, as listEndpoints describes them), the fields to track, a schedule (a preset like 24h, or a cron with timezone) and optional delivery (webhook URL, email recipients) and goal (what matters, judged by AI). The first check is queued at once; poll getMonitor or listChanges. Checks cost the underlying API's credits.

delivery.description: Where changes go; the feed always has them.

secret.description: 8 to 256 characters; requests are signed with `X-HasData-Signature: sha256=HMAC(secret, "<timestamp>.<body>")`.

endpoint.description: One of the ids from listEndpoints, e.g. `amazon_product`, `google_serp`, `web_scraping`.

fields.description: The fields to track; omit for the endpoint's defaults, send `[]` to compare the whole response.

items.description: A path into the response to compare. Without `list` the value at the path is compared as is. With `list` the value is a list of objects: `keys` names the item fields that tell items apart (none: by their content), `fields` the item fields to compare (none: the whole item). A list with keys reports added, removed and changed items; without keys, added and removed only.

fields.description: Item fields to compare, e.g. `["price", "status"]`; empty to compare whole items.

keys.description: Item fields that identify an item, e.g. `["id"]`; empty to match items by their content.

path.description: Dot-separated names into the response, e.g. `product.price.currentPrice` or `properties`.

goal.description: What matters, in plain words; with it every change is judged by AI and the verdict is stored on the result (2 credits per judged change).

name.description: Optional; without it the first resource names the monitor.

resources.description: One request per resource; up to the workspace's concurrency limit.

schedule.description: A preset, or a cron expression with a timezone; 24h by default. The minimum interval is 5 minutes.

sharedParams.description: Params set once for every resource; for Web Scraping, `aiExtractRules` (a JSON schema of what to extract from each page).

name: hasdata_monitoring_monitors_createMonitor
